body:
I'll start by examining the current files and the reference style.

Now I'll rewrite file 11, compressed.

All four chapters compressed and verified.

## Result

| File | Bytes | Sections | Sources |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `11-admin-ui.md` | 7,144 | 5 | 1, last heading |
| `12-management-api.md` | 7,195 | 4 | 1, last heading |
| `13-caching-and-performance.md` | 7,159 | 6 | 1, last heading |
| `14-observability.md` | 7,155 | 6 | 1, last heading |

Checks run: `wc -c` per file; heading scan (first `# NN — Title`, `## Sources` last, exactly one); scripted validation that every `litellm/...py|prisma` citation resolves under `/tmp/litellm-src` and every cited line is in bounds (0 issues in 22/19/16/27 refs); spot-verified line numbers against source (`proxy_server.py:2742/2847-2855/2920-2931/2982/20106/21154-21175/7744/8823`, `login_utils.py:149-160/163-175/185-202`, `admin_ui_utils.py:8`, `key_management_endpoints.py:7405-7469`, `internal_user_endpoints.py:2424-2440`, `schema.prisma:816-850`, `caching.py:131/142/338-341/377-381/410-461`, `types/caching.py:10-23`, `prometheus_metrics_server.py:1-6/33`, `prometheus_auth_middleware.py:51`, `__init__.py:161/172/197-198`, `proxy_track_cost_callback.py:1126`).

Structural changes: routed prose into 8 tables (UI route map, sign-in paths, endpoint map, pagination, config/stores, multi-worker failure modes, redaction switches, planes); collapsed the 28-line team+key recipe to 10 lines; deleted duplicate scope/preamble lines; deduped Sources (17→9 bullets for 13, 20→10 for 14).

Deliberate drops (all non-essential or duplicated):
- **11:** the `For Admin UI - allows admin to update config via UI` docstring quote (the 403 role rule and the endpoint citation are kept); duplicate `:113`/`:1334-1337` source-list entries (inline `:113`, `:1335` retained).
- **12:** `/spend/logs` line cites inside the endpoint-map row (kept with the 10,000-row cap in §4); the `/key/list` and `/key/info` curl examples (params and hash advice retained in prose); unused Sources entries `:8199`, `team_endpoints.py:4784`, `internal_user_endpoints.py:2621`, `model_management_endpoints.py:3033`.
- **13:** the standalone `# cache/flushall` curl (semantics + citation retained); `caching_redis.md` (uncited anywhere in body); the closing "hit rate, not latency, moves spend" aphorism; Kubernetes worker guidance merged into the Pool bullet.
- **14:** 9 of 28 accepted callback names (`datadog_llm_observability`, `arize_phoenix`, `langtrace`, `opik`, `azure_sentinel`, `logfire`, `deepeval`, `argilla`, `datadog_metrics` — enum cited, 19 exemplars kept); the duplicated trailing "these are OSS" restatement; the standalone Prometheus YAML block (key shown inline).

Nothing outside the four assigned files was touched, and no global verifier was run.
